name: Y9

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 8.0 Oreo + EMUI 8, Current: Android 9 Pie + EMUI 9
Platform.CPU: Kirin 659 (16 nm), Octa-core (4x2.36 GHz Cortex-A53 & 4x1.7 GHz Cortex-A53)

Cameras.Rear camera: 16 MP, f/2.2, 27 mm (wide-angle), PDAF + 2 MP, f/2.4, (depth sensor), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30fps
Cameras.Front camera: 13 MP, f/2.0, 26 mm (wide-angle) + 2 MP (depth sensor), or, 16 MP, f/2.0, 26 mm (wide-angle), 1/3.06", 1.0 μm + 2 MP (depth sensor), HDR, Video: 1080p@30fps

Connectivity.Connectivity: MicroUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm Audio, Bluetooth 4.2 (A2DP, LE, aptX), FM radio, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n (Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot), GPS, A-GPS, GLONASS, BDS
